text:
Sara V: Hey #help — new hire Alex K joined today and hasn't received his monitor + dock. Ticket IT-4823 shows 'label created' but no scans. Who's the best person to ping to get an expedited resend? He needs to pair tomorrow morning. @Marie (IT) any ETA?

Alex K: Yup, package was supposed to arrive today. I'm remote (Seattle). Tracking only shows label created. My laptop works but I need the USB-C dock and 34" monitor to run dev environment. Appreciate any help.

it-shipping-bot: Carrier update for IT-4823 — status: label_created, created_at: 2026-03-20T14:12:00Z

Marie (IT): Thanks for flagging. I pulled IT-4823 — label created 3 days ago and no carrier scans. Can you DM me the order email or paste the tracking number here? Sometimes the vendor marks shipped but carrier never picks up. I can escalate to the supplier or cancel + re-order expedited.

Dan R: FWIW I had the same thing last month. Quick steps that worked: 1) open escalation in vendor portal, 2) CC support@redwood.com, 3) if no movement by EOD escalate to overnight replacement. Also check the serial/model on the order (34" ultrawide vs 27") so IT orders the right monitor.

Sara V: Sending details now.

Alex K: Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784 (UPS). Order placed 2026-03-20. Shipping address is my home.

Marie (IT): Got it, thanks. I'll give the carrier until 10:30 PST tomorrow for a first scan. If there's still no scan I'll cancel and re-order expedited first thing. Meanwhile we can ship a loaner 24" monitor + generic USB-C dock via FedEx overnight if you'd like — should land tomorrow and unblock your pairing sessions. Can you confirm you want the loaner?

Alex K: Loaner would be great, thanks! That would unblock me.

Marie (IT): Cool. Checklist for onboarding while we wait: 1) If loaner arrives, plug into laptop and confirm display + USB peripherals work. 2) If Wi-Fi profile doesn't come down automatically, run: `redwood-wifi-setup --enroll` or open a ticket and we'll push the cert. 3) If the dock has TB3 vs TB4 issues, ping me with the dock model and we'll swap adapters.

Marie (IT): I'm adding a comment and next steps to the ticket now and will update when the loaner ships. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-4823

Sara V: :thumbsup::package: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help.
